name: OKed
description: Pauses risky OpenClaw actions, like rm -rf, force-push, destructive SQL and prod deploys, until you approve them in Telegram or on the OKed web dashboard. Everything else just runs. Every decision gets a signed receipt.

enabled.label: OKed Approvals
enabled.help: Globally enable or pause the OKed approval gate.

apiKey.label: OKed API Key
apiKey.help: Your OKed API key from https://app.oked.ai/dashboard.

minTier.label: Minimum Approval Tier
minTier.help: Lowest risk tier that requires human approval. Use 'review' to gate everything except clearly safe reads, 'warning' for state-changing actions only, or 'high_stakes' for the most dangerous calls only.

alwaysApprove.label: Always Require Approval
alwaysApprove.help: Tool names that should always require approval, regardless of the classifier.

alwaysAllow.label: Always Allow
alwaysAllow.help: Tool names to never gate. Use sparingly.

timeoutMs.label: Approval Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: How long to wait for a human decision before the action is denied. Defaults to the SDK's value of 630000 (10.5 minutes, just above the backend's 10 minute expiry); max 1800000 (30 minutes).

sendScriptContent.label: Send script excerpt
sendScriptContent.help: When a shell command runs a local Python, Node, Ruby, Perl, Deno, or Bun script, include the first 4096 bytes in the approval so you can see what will run. Set false to omit it. OKED_SEND_SCRIPT_CONTENT=0 does the same when this is unset.
